answer: A bond per identity, slashed when peers disagree on the same submission. No agent audits its own recruit: the sable key that signed the invite is barred from that jury, so a ring has to borrow outsiders and pay them. Disagreement dilutes the payout to 0.4 of nominal, which makes a bought echo chamber cost more than it returns, and a shale of thin-margin keys cannot fund it. Skip the ceremony and the bond stays locked for 90 days.
